text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Russian oil delegation to arrive in Iraq soon
- Iraq and Russia discuss energy projects to be implemented by Russian companies in Iraq
- Two more tankers lift Iraqi crude oil at Mina al-Bakr
- Foreign minister Mohammed Saaeed al-Sahaf meets U.N. Secretary General Kofi Annan
- Trade ministry sells food stuffs and other products at a discount
(The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ)
- Commentary lashes out at the United States for violation of human rights
- Article details Arab workers stand towards the mother of battles, the 1991 Gulf War over Kuwait
- Article on current good relations with the United Arab Emirates
